sources.replay-ancestry.py:
import bisect, collections, json, re
from pathlib import Path

prior = json.loads(Path('docs/performance/unresolved-roots-cpu-20261006.json').read_text())
results = []
for run in prior['runs']:
    scene = run['scene']
    p = Path(run['rawPerfPath']).parent
    table = {}
    for line in (p / 'managed-perf.map').read_text().splitlines():
        parts = line.split(' ', 2)
        if len(parts) == 3:
            start, length = int(parts[0], 16), int(parts[1], 16)
            table[start] = (start + length, parts[2])
    addresses = sorted(table)
    def resolve(pc):
        index = bisect.bisect_right(addresses, pc) - 1
        if index >= 0:
            end, name = table[addresses[index]]
            if pc < end:
                return name
        return ''
    cpu = run['cpu']
    samples = cycles = 0
    groups = collections.Counter()
    callers = collections.Counter()
    for block in (p / 'frames.txt').read_text().split('\n\n'):
        lines = block.splitlines()
        if not lines:
            continue
        match = re.match(r'^(\d+\.\d+):\s+(\d+)', lines[0])
        if not match:
            raise ValueError(lines[0])
        time, period = float(match[1]), int(match[2])
        if not cpu['startMonotonic'] <= time <= cpu['endMonotonic']:
            continue
        samples += 1
        cycles += period
        names = [resolve(int(line.split()[0], 16)) for line in lines[1:] if line.strip()]
        replay = any(re.search(r'CombatBeamSolver::Replay(?:\[|\(|$)', name) for name in names)
        if not replay:
            continue
        groups['inclusiveReplay'] += period
        if any('ReplayAction' in name for name in names):
            groups['withReplayActionAncestry'] += period
        else:
            groups['withoutResolvedReplayActionAncestry'] += period
            for name in names:
                if 'CombatSolver.CombatBeamSolver' in name and not re.search(r'::Replay(?:\[|\(|$)', name):
                    callers[name] += period
                    break
    assert samples == cpu['includedSamples'], (scene, samples, cpu['includedSamples'])
    assert cycles == cpu['estimatedCycles'], (scene, cycles, cpu['estimatedCycles'])
    result = dict(scene=scene, samples=samples, cycles=cycles,
                  groups={name:dict(cycles=value, percent=100*value/cycles) for name,value in groups.items()},
                  nearestOtherSolverFrames=[dict(frame=name, percent=100*value/cycles) for name,value in callers.most_common(12)])
    results.append(result)
    print(json.dumps(result), flush=True)
output = dict(scope='Same two complete-request CPU windows; inclusive Replay paths overlap Snapshot/Fork. Missing ReplayAction ancestry is not proof of a root replay; inlining and unresolved frames limit interpretation. No timing acceptance or call counts.',
              priorEvidence='docs/performance/unresolved-roots-cpu-20261006.json',
              runtimeBaseline=prior['runtimeBaseline'], sourceCommit=prior['sourceCommit'], results=results)
Path('.local/tool-tasks/power-only-listener-suffix-20261006/replay-ancestry.json').write_text(json.dumps(output,indent=2)+'\n')
